components.title: Calculate the final price
components.what: Starting from $245.00, apply the sequential multipliers 1.25, 0.92, and 1.09, then round the result to the nearest cent.

components.title: Format the response
components.what: Show brief working, then end with exactly one line of the form FINAL: <answer>. For the numeric answer, use digits only with no units, currency sign, or commas, and use a decimal point.
